definitions.explanation: The visible vapor released from burning material.

examples.japanese: ⟦タバコ→たばこ：02909_tabako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{煙|けむり}

examples.english: My eyes hurt from the smoke.

examples.japanese: {煙|けむり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}っている→立ち上る：10670_tachinoboru⟧。
⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{煙|けむり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ていた→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Smoke was coming from the factory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{火事|かじ}→火事：01283_kaji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{煙|けむり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{空|そら}→空：02216_sora⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がり→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧、⟦{遠|とお}く→遠い：00529_tooi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{見|み}えた→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: The smoke from the fire spread across the sky and could be seen from far away.

notes:
{煙|けむり} is the visible vapor produced by burning materials.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {煙|けむり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: smoke comes out
- {煙|けむり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}る→立ち上る：10670_tachinoboru⟧: smoke rises
- {煙|けむり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸|す}う→吸う：04394_suu⟧: to inhale smoke
- {煙|けむり}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{巻|ま}く→巻く：02418_maku⟧: to confuse, evade (idiom)

TYPES OF SMOKE:
- ⟦タバコ→たばこ：02909_tabako⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{煙|けむり}: cigarette smoke
- ⟦{排気|はいき}→排気：18980_haiki⟧⟦ガス→ガス：01344_gasu⟧: exhaust fumes
- ⟦{煙霧|えんむ}→煙霧：28015_enmu⟧: smoky haze

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{煙突|えんとつ}→煙突：02271_entotsu⟧: chimney
- ⟦{煙|けむ}い→煙い：03941_kemui⟧: smoky (i-adjective)
- ⟦{煙|けむ}たい→煙たい：15245_kemutai⟧: smoky; annoying (figurative)

WRITING:
The kanji {煙|けむり} can also be read as けむ in compounds like ⟦{煙|けむ}たがる→煙たがる：27888_kemutagaru⟧ (to find someone bothersome).
